sentences.text: Robert Boyd Holbrook -LRB- born circa 1981 -RRB- is an American actor and fashion model .

He has appeared in films such as Milk , Out of the Furnace , Run All Night , A Walk Among the Tombstones , and Gone Girl , and stars as DEA Agent Steve Murphy in the Netflix series Narcos .
